collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After an unexpected storm, a fisher wonders whether distant people can tell when storms are coming far in advance.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After an unexpected storm, (name1), a fisher, wonders whether distant people can tell when storms are coming far in advance.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The fisher imagines people who watch clouds, winds and birds just as Isolans do.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A scholar wonders whether they might have tools that measure the wind and the weight of the air.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder suggests that storms might surprise everyone, everywhere, sometimes.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A child finds this oddly comforting.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They disagree about what the clouds mean and keep arguing happily.

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: The fishers agree to share their observations each morning.
